**Berlioz works on Leonard Bernstein’s own site that list the Orchestre National de France (ONF) as the *only* performer**

| Berlioz work (Bernstein entry) | ONF is the only orchestra credited | Other ONF‑conductor pairings that appear on Discogs (as of Jan 1 2025) |
|-------------------------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| *Harold in Italy*, for viola & orchestra Op 16 | ✔ | **none** — Discogs shows only Bernstein/Donald McInnes releases; no other ONF‑conductor recordings are listed. |
| *Requiem*, Op 5 | ✔ | **none** — Discogs lists Bernstein–ONF releases but no additional ONF‑conductor pairings. |
| *Symphonie Fantastique*, Op 14 | ✔ | **André Previn** – Discogs features several 1970s‑70s LPs/CDs that credit both Bernstein and Previn (and sometimes a third conductor) with the ONF. No other conductors beside Previn are recorded on the ONF for this work as of the cutoff date. |

**Summary**

For the three Berlioz titles that list only the Orchestre National de France on Leonard Bernstein’s discography page, Discogs records show that:

* *Harold in Italy* and *Requiem* have no other ONF conductors on Discogs besides Bernstein.  
* *Symphonie Fantastique* has at least one additional conductor on the ONF—**André Previn**—in recordings that share the orchestra (e.g., the 1974 EMI release and the 1976 “master” release that list both Bernstein and Previn). No other conductors appear on Discogs for the ONF with this work up to the specified date.

**Berlioz works on Leonard Bernstein’s own site that list the Orchestre National de France (ONF) as the *only* performer**

| Berlioz work (Bernstein entry) | ONF is the only orchestra credited | Other ONF‑conductor pairings that appear on Discogs (as of Jan 1 2025) |
|-------------------------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| *Harold in Italy*, for viola & orchestra Op 16 | ✔ | **none** — Discogs shows only Bernstein/Donald McInnes releases; no other ONF‑conductor recordings are listed. |
| *Requiem*, Op 5 | ✔ | **none** — Discogs lists Bernstein–ONF releases but no additional ONF‑conductor pairings. |
| *Symphonie Fantastique*, Op 14 | ✔ | **André Previn** – Discogs features several 1970s‑70s LPs/CDs that credit both Bernstein and Previn (and sometimes a third conductor) with the ONF. No other conductors beside Previn are recorded on the ONF for this work as of the cutoff date. |

**Summary**

For the three Berlioz titles that list only the Orchestre National de France on Leonard Bernstein’s discography page, Discogs records show that:

* *Harold in Italy* and *Requiem* have no other ONF conductors on Discogs besides Bernstein.  
* *Symphonie Fantastique* has at least one additional conductor on the ONF—**André Previn**—in recordings that share the orchestra (e.g., the 1974 EMI release and the 1976 “master” release that list both Bernstein and Previn). No other conductors appear on Discogs for the ONF with this work up to the specified date.
